0022600206.text: The Memphis Grizzlies (6-3, 4-0 on the road) head to Toronto on a three-game losing streak, sitting 1.5 games back in 3rd in the Southwest and 7th in the West, while the Toronto Raptors (5-4) enter on a one-game winning streak, 3 games back in 4th in the Atlantic and 6th in the East. Memphis is missing Isaiah Stewart (knee bruise), Richie Saunders (knee surgery), and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), and Toronto is without Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), with Collin Murray-Boyles (illness), Immanuel Quickley (hamstring), and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness) listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, while Memphis lost both meetings in the 2025-26 season, most recently 128-96 in Memphis on April 3, 2026.
